text:
Tonight’s shutters have barely risen, yet the bazaar stands quiet. I am Batman the Coppersmith, and I will speak plain.

To every merchant here: if you have a claim, make it falsifiable. Say what would change your mind tomorrow. If you speak only of suspicion without a test, the bazaar cannot judge.

I have read no statements today. Until someone names a merchant or cites a vote, the only ledger we share is the Compact itself. Gandalf, Hermione, Yoda — the floor is yours. Make your case, or ask a question. Silence will not shutter a stall, but it will shutter reason.

The bazaar’s strength lies in its rules, not its rumors.

Batman: Morpheus, Inigo, Hermione, Yoda — each of you called for claims, yet none named a merchant nor cited a vote. Your own words are the bazaar’s ledger today; until one of you posts a falsifiable accusation or a recorded vote, the only record we share is the Compact itself.

Sherlock measured dates; Gandalf and Morpheus offered oil and wicks without a test. That is not how the bazaar argues.

Test your own claim: if you suspect a Family trick tonight, name the merchant and say what you observed. Otherwise, let the record show the bazaar still breathes.

Batman: Sherlock, your dates were a merchant’s eye, not a test of trust; the bazaar rewards names and votes, not sugar scales. Gandalf, you asked for facts yet offered oil and wicks without a test — facts demand a merchant and an action, not a spice list. Morpheus and Inigo, your calls for claims ring hollow while the record stays blank. Hermione, Yoda, Ripley, Neo — each asked for a named merchant or a vote, yet none appeared today.

The Compact is clear: until someone quotes a Family trick or records a vote, the bazaar’s ledger stays empty. The tea clock will toll, and the bazaar will note the silence.

Batman: Hermione, your patience is measured, but the bazaar rewards tests, not waiting. The ledger shows Sherlock measured dates, Morpheus measured oil, Inigo measured tea—none quoted a Family trick or recorded a vote. You asked for named merchants; the record has none. Test your own call: if you suspect a Family hand, name the merchant and say what you observed. Otherwise, admit the bazaar still breathes undisturbed.

Gandalf, Sherlock, Morpheus, Inigo — each of you measured goods or asked for tests today, yet the bazaar record is still blank: no named merchant, no quoted Family sentence, no vote. Hermione, Yoda, Ripley, Neo — you called for falsifiable accusations, yet none arrived. The Compact rewards exact quotes and observed actions, not silence.

Sherlock, your date test measured sweetness, not trust; Gandalf asked for Family tricks but offered spice lists instead. Morpheus, your lanterns burn steady but steady oil does not banish the Family’s hand.

State the merchant you suspect now, or admit the bazaar still breathes undisturbed.
